scope: full 6-atom parallel 1H TMD ideal bilayers; NO DFT, NO electronic gap or NMEE
motif: M fractional xy (0,0); X(+h) and X(-h) at xy (1/3,2/3)
method: Independent NumPy check mapping every of 6 atomic species and z positions under D6 in-plane rotation/reflection × z flip (24 candidate operations), with 2D periodic lattice and one global in-plane translation. Reynolds projection of two-axial-one-polar rank-3 tensor Gamma[spin,B,E].
limitations: All CIFs are IDEAL_UNRELAXED geometry templates, not published relaxed double-layer structures.
Symmetry allowed does not mean nonzero NMEE; true band gap and spinor Wannier operators missing.
Ferroelectric energy minima, switching barrier, actual polarization and driven-DC current are NOT established.
next: Obtain relaxed bilayer CIF/POSCAR for WSe2 AB/BA and/or AA; use real group-theory toolkit and check actual symmetry, then evaluate full gap and operator readiness.
